content: Why does Spotify's discover weekly playlist keep repeating songs I've already liked or heard? It is so frustrating. I want actual new music recommendations, not the same loop.

author: AudioHead_99
title: Shuffle algorithm is completely broken
content: Spotify shuffle is not random at all. It keeps playing the same 20 songs from my 500 song playlist. I hear the same tracks every time I click shuffle.

author: MusicDiscoverer
title: Algorithmic echo chamber is real
content: Lately my recommendations have been stuck in an echo chamber. I listened to one jazz album and now all my discovery feeds are just jazz. Let me reset my taste profile!

author: SpotifyUser_12

content: Does anyone else feel like Spotify favors familiar artists too much? I skip a song 5 times and it still shows up in my daily mixes. Bring back true discovery.

author: PlaylistGuru

content: I used to find so many underground artists on Spotify. Now it just pushes top 40 tracks or songs from artists I already follow. True discovery is dead on this platform.

author: FreePremiumLover

content: Premium user here. The repeat loop on my offline playlists is driving me crazy. Shuffle keeps repeating the exact same sequence of music on my commutes.

author: iOS_Streamer
title: Recommendation algorithm loop issue
content: The recommendation algorithm is stuck in a loop. Every radio station generated from a song plays the exact same artists. No variety at all.

author: MusicNerd2024
title: 3000 songs in playlist and same 100 play
content: can have 3,000 songs in a Playlist and it plays the same 100 songs they need to work on their rotation of songs that are played its a joke

author: DiscoverWeeklyFan
title: Discover Weekly stopped discovering
content: My Discover Weekly used to introduce me to amazing niche artists. Now it's just recycling songs I've already added to my library. The algorithm has broken down completely.

author: ShuffleHater
title: Why is shuffle so predictable
content: I've noticed Spotify shuffle follows the same rough order every single time. It's like it generates a shuffle sequence once and reuses it. This is not shuffle, this is a fixed rotation.

author: FreeUserFrustrated
title: 6 ads in a row is insane
content: I just got hit with 6 back-to-back advertisements on Spotify Free. That's nearly 3 minutes of ads. I was listening to a podcast and now I've completely lost my train of thought.

author: AdBlockerUser
title: Spotify ads are getting longer and louder
content: Has anyone else noticed that Spotify ads have gotten significantly longer and louder recently? Some of them are 60 seconds now. This feels predatory.

author: BudgetListener
title: Free tier is becoming unusable
content: The free tier experience has degraded so much. Ads every 2 songs, can't skip, can't choose songs. At this point they're basically forcing you to pay. Not everyone can afford Premium.

author: StudentStruggle
title: Spotify student discount ended and price is too high
content: Lost my student discount and the regular price feels steep for someone who's just starting out. Why can't they have a proper budget tier for developing markets?

author: TrialExpiredUser
title: 3 month trial is over and price shock is real
content: After 3 months of Premium for free, coming back to the ad-supported tier is absolutely brutal. The contrast makes the free experience feel designed to torture you into subscribing.

author: DailyMixEnjoyer
title: Daily Mix 1 is the exact same playlist for 3 weeks
content: I've been getting the same Daily Mix 1 for 3 weeks straight. Same 30 songs, same order. Can Spotify not generate a new mix more frequently than this?

author: RadioFan
title: Artist radio plays only that one artist
content: When I start a radio from an artist I like, Spotify just plays that same artist's songs over and over. Radio should explore similar artists, not become a repeat station.

author: MixedTaste
title: Spotify doesn't understand that I have diverse taste
content: I listen to metal on Mondays and classical on Sundays. Spotify has no idea how to handle this and just blends everything into a confused mush in my Daily Mixes.

author: ContextualListening
title: Work playlist recommendations bleed into everything
content: I listened to lo-fi study music for one week while working and now my entire recommendation engine thinks that's all I want. I can't escape it. Context matters, Spotify.

author: NewMusicFriday_Fan
title: Release Radar misses half my followed artists
content: My Release Radar consistently misses new releases from artists I explicitly follow. I find out about new albums from Instagram, not Spotify. What's the point of following artists?

author: HomeScreenFrustration
title: New home screen redesign is terrible
content: The 2024 home screen redesign removed the ability to quickly access my playlists. Now I have to scroll past 10 sections of AI-generated content just to find what I actually want. Bring back the old layout.

author: LibraryOrganization
title: Liked songs library has no folder organization
content: I have 4,000 liked songs and there's no way to organize them into sub-folders or genres. My entire library is just one massive unsorted list. This is basic functionality Spotify has never implemented.

author: DesktopUserRant
title: Desktop app is getting worse every update
content: Every Spotify desktop update makes it look more like the mobile app and breaks features desktop users rely on. Local files don't sync, the mini-player disappeared, drag and drop is broken.

author: PodcastMusicMixer
title: Podcasts and music should be separate apps
content: Forcing podcasts and music into one app has made both experiences worse. The recommendation algorithm gets confused and my music taste profile is now polluted with podcast listening patterns.

author: SearchBroken
title: Search results are biased toward popular content
content: When I search for a specific niche artist, Spotify shows me popular artists with similar names first. I have to scroll past Spotify's commercial suggestions to find what I actually searched for.

author: QueueManagement
title: Queue management is a nightmare
content: I can't easily rearrange songs in my queue on mobile. I add songs throughout the day and by the time I want to reorder them, the interface is so clunky I give up.

author: PlaylistCoverArt
title: Playlist auto-generated covers look awful
content: The AI-generated playlist covers Spotify creates are hideous. They used to be collages of album art which was beautiful. Now it's some random gradient that means nothing.

author: AndroidCrashVictim
title: App crashes every time I go offline
content: Spotify crashes consistently on my Android when I switch from Wi-Fi to mobile data. The transition to offline mode causes a crash and I lose my queue. This has been a bug for months.

author: SlowAppComplainer
title: App takes 8 seconds to open on my phone
content: Spotify takes 8 full seconds to open on my mid-range Android. I've cleared cache, reinstalled, everything. The app has become so bloated that it's barely functional on anything that isn't a flagship.

author: BatteryDrainUser
title: Spotify drains my battery even when not playing
content: Spotify is consuming 15% of my battery daily even when I'm not actively listening. Background processes seem to run continuously. This is inexcusable for a music app.

author: DownloadIssue
title: Downloaded songs disappear after every update
content: Every time Spotify pushes an app update, my downloaded songs for offline listening get deleted and I have to re-download everything. This has happened 4 times now on limited mobile data.

author: CrossfadeBug
title: Crossfade feature stopped working completely
content: The crossfade feature in Spotify Premium just stopped working after the last update. Songs now have an awkward silence gap between them. Basic feature, complete regression.

author: PriceHikeAngry
title: Premium went up $3 and features got worse
content: Spotify raised their Premium price by $3 last year and simultaneously made the app worse. Less customization, more algorithmic control, removed features. We're paying more for less.

author: FamilyPlanUser
title: Family plan verification is invasive
content: Spotify's family plan location verification is unacceptably invasive. Asking family members to share their GPS location to continue using a music subscription they paid for is a terrible user experience.

author: UpgradeIntentUser
title: Would upgrade to Premium but can't justify it
content: I want to go Premium for the offline feature and no ads, but I can't justify it when YouTube Music offers the same features for slightly less. Spotify needs to add genuine exclusive value.

author: CancellationNightmare
title: Cancelling Spotify was harder than subscribing
content: It took me 6 clicks to subscribe to Premium and 11 screens to cancel. Classic dark pattern design. I'm cancelling because of this alone. If you make it this hard to leave, you've already lost my goodwill.

author: OfflineCommuter
title: Offline playlists randomly stop working on commute
content: I take the subway daily and rely on offline playlists. At least twice a week, Spotify tells me it can't play offline content because I haven't connected to the internet recently. I'm underground. That's the whole point of offline.

author: StorageLimited
title: Offline storage limit is too low for audiophiles
content: The download storage cap means I can't store my entire curated collection offline. Other apps let you use as much storage as you have. Spotify's artificial limit is frustrating for heavy users.

author: CarModeUser
title: Offline sync doesn't work in car mode
content: Spotify Car View doesn't properly show which tracks are downloaded vs streaming. I've burned through my mobile data because I thought I was playing downloaded music but wasn't.

author: SocialFeaturesGone
title: They removed the friends activity feed
content: Spotify quietly removed the friends listening activity from the desktop sidebar in the latest update. This was one of my favorite features for music discovery. Why do they keep removing good features?

author: CollaborativePlaylist
title: Collaborative playlists have too many limitations
content: Collaborative playlists don't notify you when friends add songs, don't show who added what, and don't support voting. This feature has had zero development for years. It feels abandoned.

author: ShareFeatureDisappeared
title: Sharing to Instagram stories is broken
content: The Instagram story share feature from Spotify has been broken for 3 months. I get an error every time I try to share what I'm listening to. This is a core social feature that drives organic marketing.

author: AlgorithmBlackBox
title: Why can't I see why Spotify recommends something
content: I wish Spotify would tell me why they're recommending a particular song. Netflix tells you 'because you watched X'. Spotify just throws songs at you with zero explanation. Transparency would build trust.

author: TasteProfileReset
title: Need ability to reset or edit taste profile
content: I let my little sibling use my account for a week and now my entire taste profile is destroyed. Spotify thinks I'm into children's music and K-pop. There's no way to reset or edit your listening history. This is a critical missing feature.

author: PrivateSessions
title: Private session doesn't truly isolate listening
content: Even with private sessions turned on, certain songs I play seem to bleed into my recommendations. If private session is supposed to prevent algorithmic learning, it's not working as advertised.

author: CensoredContent
title: Spotify removing niche music I love
content: Spotify has been removing smaller artists from their platform without explanation. I've lost several playlists because the music was pulled. Where does this music go? How do artists get their music back?

author: PodcastSpam
title: Podcast recommendations clogging my home screen
content: I don't listen to podcasts but Spotify won't stop pushing them on my home screen. I've dismissed the recommendations repeatedly. There's no option to permanently hide podcasts from music-only users.

author: AudiobookPush
title: Audiobooks I never asked for keep appearing
content: Audiobooks now take up an entire section of my home screen. I've never played an audiobook on Spotify. This is a purely commercial decision to push a new product at the expense of user experience.

author: ExplicitFilter
title: Explicit filter is inconsistent and unreliable
content: I set Spotify to filter explicit content for my kids' profile but explicit tracks still slip through regularly. The explicit tagging is inconsistent and the filter doesn't work properly. This is a safety issue.

author: SleepTimerRequest
title: Sleep timer feature needs improvement urgently
content: The sleep timer stops mid-song and abruptly cuts off music. It should fade out gracefully. Also why isn't there a 'end of episode' option for podcasts? This feature feels half-implemented.
